response.overview: A conversation with Director Brian De Palma and Actors Al Pacino, Michelle Pfeiffer, and Steven Bauer. From New York City's Beacon Theater, April 19th, 2018. Discussions include project origins, the film's violence and language, the picture in retrospect, the film's rating, performances and the physical demands thereof, the film's lasting legacy, Pacino's burn injury during the shoot, Oliver Stone's script, possibilities for a remake, cast takeaways from the experience, and more. (Blu-ray.com)
response.title: Scarface: 35th Anniversary Reunion
